# Starter kits

<!-- Generated by `bun run docs` from packages/core/src/config/presets.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Use one with `npx statuscraft apply <id>`, or pick it in the editor.

## 🧱 Starter (`starter`)

Model, context, branch and changes. A great first status line.

```
Opus 5.5 │ Ctx 56% │ feature/login │ +128 -31
```

## 🌙 Minimal (`minimal`)

Just the model and a context bar. Calm and quiet.

```
Opus 5.5  ▰▰▰▰▱▱▱▱ 56%
```

## 😄 Pip (`pip`)

Pip the brick keeps you company and panics when context runs low.

```
(•_•)  Opus 5.5  ▰▰▰▰▰▰▱▱▱▱ 56%  feature/login
```

## 🎨 Bricks (`bricks`)

Bright toy-brick colors with powerline arrows. Needs a [Nerd Font](https://www.nerdfonts.com).

```
 Opus 5.5  src  feature/login  +128 -31  Ctx 56% 
```

## 💰 Budget Watch (`budget`)

Cost, rate limits and reset timer, so you never hit a wall by surprise.

```
Opus 5.5 │ Cost $3.87 │ 5h 47% ↻2h20m │ 7d 38% ↻3d0h │ ██████░░░░ 56%
```

## 🌿 Git Guru (`git`)

Repo, branch, PR status and changes at a glance.

```
acme/my-app │ feature/login ↑3 │ ✚7 ?2 │ PR #1234 …                     +412 -97
```

## 🚀 Two-Liner Pro (`pro`)

Everything that matters on two lines: session on top, budget below. Needs a [Nerd Font](https://www.nerdfonts.com).

```
 Opus 5.5  Effort high  src  feature/login  PR #1234 … 
 ███████░░░░░ 56%  Cache warm 91%  Cost $3.87  5h 47% ↻2h20m  Session ... 
```

## ❄️ Nordic (`nord`)

Cool arctic powerline: folder, branch, context and cost. Needs a [Nerd Font](https://www.nerdfonts.com).

```
 src  feature/login  Ctx 56%  Cost $3.87 
```
